criteria.label: We have the access we need

answer_meaning.Y: Fully supported by evidence meeting the criterion statement's qualification standard
answer_meaning.N: Evidence contradicts or fails the standard

qualification_scorecard.guidance: The five criteria are qualification tests, not optimism scores. Use Y only when the complete statement in Criteria Statements is supported by direct evidence. See Method & Governance tab.

role_etuc.unverified_suffix: A trailing '?' (e.g. 'E?') marks a hypothesized role pending confirmation - never render as confirmed in the Blue Sheet tab.

rating_scale.meaning: Owner's assessed support level for this Single Sales Objective; negative is opposed, positive is supportive. Always a hypothesis/analyst-judgment field per Section 8 governance unless the customer has explicitly stated their position.

coach_qualification_test: We have credibility with the person.
The person has credibility with the Buying Influences for this Single Sales Objective.
The person wants our solution above all others and will advocate for it.
buying_influence_vocabulary.governance: Economic Buying Influence, Coach, personal win, mode, competitive preference, and rating are approval-required fields per Section 8 of the Blue Sheet Automation Spec. Automation may only change the 'current_read', 'access', and factual role/title/location cells outright; the rest must be written as a proposed change.
